clauses.clause: Whenever you activate a loyalty ability of a Chandra planeswalker, this creature deals 1 damage to each opponent.
clauses.evidence: No trace stimulus activates a planeswalker loyalty ability (the probe's you_chandra is a synthetic 'Creature — Chandra' 2/2, probe.py:159, which is why Crash Through gives it trample). Packs: keral_keep_disciples_only_your_chandra (the opponent's Chandra, Flame's Catalyst +1 does not trigger it: you 17, opp 20 after it; your own Catalyst +1 then deals 3 + 1: opp 16) PASS; keral_keep_disciples_non_chandra_no_trigger (your Basri Ket +1: no damage) PASS. Tree is the canonical B2b-keral-keep-disciples (AbilityActivatedEvent: Chandra Planeswalker source, LOYALTY kind, actor YOU; EachPlayer ALL_OPPONENTS DEAL_DAMAGE 1).
